instruction.text: Add 1 pencil to the purple box.
instruction.sound: There are 3 pencils in the yellow box. Add one more pencil to the purple box by selecting the screen once.

instruction.text: How many pencils can you see?
instruction.sound: How many pencils are there altogether?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Well done. Three pencils <break time='100ms'/> plus one pencil <break time='100ms'/> equals four pencils.

instruction.text: Add 2 apples to the purple box.
instruction.sound: There are 5 apples in the yellow box. Add two apples to the purple box by selecting the screen twice.

instruction.text: How many apples can you see?
instruction.sound: How many apples are there altogether?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Exactly. Five apples<break time='100ms'/> plus two apples<break time='100ms'/> equals seven apples

instruction.text: Add 1 car to the purple box.
instruction.sound: There are 4 cars in the yellow box. Add one more car to the purple box.

instruction.text: How many cars can you see?
instruction.sound: How many cars are there altogether?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Good job! Four cars <break time='100ms'/> plus one car <break time='100ms'/> equals five cars.

instruction.text: Add 2 presents to the purple box.
instruction.sound: There are 3 presents in the yellow box. Add two presents to the purple box.

instruction.text: How many presents can you see?
instruction.sound: How many presents are there altogether?

trainers.finishSound: ssml: Correct! Three presents <break time='100ms'/> plus two presents <break time='100ms'/> equals five presents. <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>cheering kids</voice>
